title: Fitting Bayesian MAR — mar_bayes
text: y Matrix-valued time series data p VAR lag (Default: 1) exogen Unmodeled matrices s Lag exogeneous matrices MARX(p, s). default, s = 0. factor_spec Augmented factor matrix specification. num_chains Number MCMC chains num_iter MCMC iteration number num_burn Number burn-(warm-). Half iteration default choice. thinning Thinning every thinning-th iteration row_spec Row coefficient specification col_spec Column coefficient specification exogen_row_spec Exogenous row coefficient prior specification. exogen_col_spec Exogenous column coefficient prior specification. factor_row_spec Factor row coefficient prior specification. factor_col_spec Factor column coefficient prior specification. verbose Progress log num_thread Number threads
